description: Create a new role in a server. Requires the Manage Roles permission; the new role is placed below the bot's highest role. Use discord_add_role to then assign it to members. Returns the new role's name and ID.

color.description: Role color as a hex string, e.g. '#FF5733'.

hoist.description: If true, display members with this role separately in the member list.

mentionable.description: If true, anyone can @mention this role.

name.description: Name of the new role (max 100 characters).

permissions.description: Server-wide permission flag names to grant, e.g. ['SendMessages','ViewChannel']. Uses Discord PermissionsBitField flag names.

name: discord_create_role
